SELECT * FROM arte_ai_assistant_tool WHERE assistant_id = #{assistantId} ORDER BY sort_order, id

SELECT association.binding_id, association.sort_order, association.policy_override AS assistant_policy_override, binding.workspace_id, binding.tool_id, binding.tool_version, binding.credential_reference AS binding_credential_reference, binding.configuration AS binding_configuration, binding.policy_override AS binding_policy_override, tool.provider_id, tool.namespace, tool.name, version.default_configuration, version.default_policy, provider.credential_reference AS provider_credential_reference FROM arte_ai_assistant_tool association INNER JOIN arte_ai_tool_binding binding ON binding.binding_id = association.binding_id AND binding.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND binding.enabled = 1 INNER JOIN arte_ai_tool tool ON tool.tool_id = binding.tool_id AND tool.lifecycle_state = 'published' INNER JOIN arte_ai_tool_version version ON version.tool_id = binding.tool_id AND version.version = binding.tool_version AND version.lifecycle_state = 'published' INNER JOIN arte_ai_tool_provider provider ON provider.provider_id = tool.provider_id AND provider.status = 'enabled' WHERE association.assistant_id = #{assistantId} AND association.enabled = 1 AND (binding.workspace_id IS NULL OR binding.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) ORDER BY association.sort_order, association.id
